chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Hassan, from Musa ibn Bakr, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) the first used to frequently eat sugar at sleep time.

key_terms.أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الْأَوَّلُ: Abu Al-Hasan the First (referring to Imam Al-Hasan ibn Ali)

ai.seo_question: What was Imam Al-Hasan's habit regarding sugar consumption before sleep?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Kafi highlights Imam Al-Hasan al-Askari’s (peace be upon him) personal habit of consuming sugar before sleep, reflecting the practical application of dietary recommendations in Shia tradition. While often cited in contemporary contexts for its potential health benefits, the hadith primarily serves to illustrate the Imam’s daily routine and the importance of moderation in consumption. It underscores the holistic approach of the Imams, where even mundane habits are imbued with wisdom and spiritual significance.
